title: Cosmic Software Hardware Duality
definition: A metaphysical model that conceptualizes consciousness as a universal software running on temporary hardware, which explains the human experience of life and death.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of consciousness as a software program that runs on different hardware. When the hardware breaks down (death), the software continues to exist but needs to find another compatible hardware to run on (reincarnation).
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Consciousness is not generated by the brain but is a fundamental property of the universe that interacts with a compatible biological receiver. Consciousness patterns exist as potentials in the field and couple with new, compatible hardware to start a 'life session'.
difficulty_levels.expert: The Cosmic Software-Hardware Duality is a novel metaphysical model that not only provides a unified explanation for life and death but also re-frames the universe as a vast open-source project. This duality challenges traditional notions of substance dualism and materialism, suggesting a more interconnected and dynamic relationship between software (consciousness) and hardware (physical reality).

extra_fields.insight: We have reverse-engineered the universe based on first principles of feeling and reason, coherently hypothesizing the origin, activation, and path of consciousness.
